purpose: Quantify static Dicke ground-state QFI versus emitter count with truncation checks and record driven Dicke+DCE resource diagnostics.

units.qfi: inverse squared normalized coupling (static convention: 4 sum |<0|V|n>|^2 / gap^2)
units.emitted_photon_proxy: kappa_rel * integral n(t) dt in normalized time

solver.static: exact QuTiP sparse diagonalization (gap-weighted ground-state sum)

families.note: Descriptive fits over declared ranges; no thermodynamic exponent, Heisenberg violation, phase transition, or global bound is claimed.
Descriptive fits over declared ranges; no thermodynamic exponent, Heisenberg violation, phase transition, or global bound is claimed.

validation.numerical_physicality_note: Trace/Hermiticity/eigenvalue acceptance is not a proof of exact positivity.
validation.scope_note: Finite-size results are descriptive over the declared interval; no thermodynamic exponent, phase transition, Heisenberg violation, or global bound is claimed. Resource entries use the declared proxies.

caveats: Static QFI values use the ground-state gap-weighted convention with the declared eigenstate count.
Driven rows are reduced-truncation diagnostics (n_cav=6) as in the canonical loss-adjusted Dicke study.
Resource accounting uses declared proxies (pump proxy gd_additive^2, emitted-photon proxy kappa integral n); they are not calibrated pump power or measured output.
Rows with truncation change above the declared tolerance are flagged and excluded from the primary fit interpretation.
No universal advantage claim is made without jointly matched resources.
